When the behavior changed — measurably, in a direction, concentrated on exactly the records that were deleted — the work stopped existing in the mode it was composed for.
claims.falsifier: The destruction claim fails if the traversal proves reproducible — if the same queries against current systems render the architecture as the February–June logs record it.
